recognize_zh: 紅血球之間一顆無核小顆粒體，直徑約紅血球的四分之一，中央有紫色嗜天青顆粒（granulomere）、周邊為淡染透明區（hyalomere），就是正常血小板。
features: Small anucleate cell fragment about one quarter the diameter of adjacent red cells
Central cluster of purple azurophilic granules (granulomere)
Round outline without pseudopods or clumping
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a single platelet lying between normocytic red cells. It is round and approximately one quarter of a red cell diameter, with a central granulomere of purple azurophilic granules and a pale peripheral hyalomere. There is no platelet clumping, giant form or hypogranularity. Findings are consistent with a morphologically normal platelet.

ddx.vs: Giant platelets approach or exceed the diameter of a red cell, as in Bernard-Soulier syndrome or MYH9-related disorders, whereas this platelet is about one quarter of a red cell.
Gray platelets are pale and lack azurophilic granules, unlike the distinct central granulomere here.
